title: A document of exactly 1 MiB
why: Inclusive, like every other cap in `v1` — 1 MiB is legal and one byte more refuses. Its absence was reachable: an engine comparing `>=` against the ceiling refuses this document and passes every other case, because the over-cap fixture overshoots by the whole of its surrounding JSON. The acceptance is an ordinary valid one, so the case pins that the document is *evaluated*, not merely not-refused.
